author: CreeperJoe62
body: This command is very simple. For example if a mod was dealing with a player report the mod could do /Nick bob for example. When that was done the mod rank would disappear and if the mod had donated it would say Emerald bob. This would stop hackers from quitting if they see the mod and it would also stop mods from being pointed out by players.
